_readme: S748, lane 2's cheap piles (2026-11-28). Two Fullerton records fail on coverage alone: the state's list names THEA 231 F for Stage Management 18749 and PE 108 F for Kinesiology A.A.-T 36863, and the committed capture finds neither on its page. Plan s748c files state_course_not_on_page on the capture's finding. This read prints each page as the capture reads it, so a session and the plan's second reader can see for themselves whether any line prints the course. Two loads. No model call, nothing written.

questions.thea_231: Whether the Stage Management certificate page prints THEA 231 F on any line, and each list it prints.
questions.pe_108: Whether the Kinesiology A.A.-T page prints PE 108 F on any line, and each list it prints.
